## Executive summary

Panev Ascensori SAS is an Italian manufacturer based in Vittuone (near Milan, Lombardy) specializing in patented brackets ("staffe") for elevator and dumbwaiter doors and counterweights. The company holds UIBM Patent No. 202023000002112 (granted 2025-01-07) for an articulated, drilled, slotted bracket system that simplifies installation and allows ±7-8° adjustment on-site. Beyond manufacturing, the company provides installation, maintenance, modernization, and 24/7 emergency services throughout Italy.

**Co-founders:** Ivaylo Yordanov Panev, Stefan Lyubomirov Kostadinov (each 50%)

**Market:** Italian B2B — elevator installers, condominiums, maintenance companies, designers
**Language:** Italian

**Service coverage:** National (all Italy), with Milan-area focus for on-site services

## Patent details

**Number:** 202023000002112
**Type:** Modello di Utilità (Utility Model Patent)
**Granting authority:** UIBM — Ufficio Italiano Brevetti e Marchi (Italian Patent and Trademark Office, part of Ministero delle Imprese e del Made in Italy)
**Filing date:** 2023-05-19
**Grant date:** 2025-01-07
**IPC classification:** B66B (elevators, escalators, moving walkways)

**Title:** Staffa di supporto per un componente strutturale di un impianto di ascensore o montacarichi
(English: "Support bracket for a structural component of an elevator or dumbwaiter installation")

**Inventors:**
- Ivaylo Yordanov Panev (50%)
- Stefan Lyubomirov Kostadinov (50%)

**Key patent claim:** An ambidextrous (left/right interchangeable) bracket system featuring perforated plates, articulated joints, and slotted holes that allow:
- On-site angular adjustment of ±7° to ±8° without custom fabrication
- Single SKU covers both left and right door orientations (reduces inventory 50%)
- Combination with standard guide rails for both door and counterweight applications

## Services

### Installation
Complete turnkey installation of new elevators and dumbwaiters. Includes shaft preparation assessment, component supply (including Panev patented brackets), assembly, testing, and certification. Coverage: entire Italian territory.

### Maintenance
Annual and biannual maintenance contracts. Includes periodic inspection (UNI EN 81 compliance), preventive maintenance of mechanical/electrical components, lubrication, safety device testing, and documentation. 24/7 emergency call-out line for clients under contract: +39 392 684 8978.

### Modernization
Upgrade of existing installations: bracket replacement for deteriorated systems, door mechanism upgrades, control panel updates, accessibility compliance updates (D.M. 236/1989, UNI EN 81-70 for disability access).

### Certification
Support for CE marking, UNI 10411 compliance, and technical documentation preparation. Partnership with notified bodies for Type Examination Certificates when required.

## Target audience

**Primary customers (B2B):**
- Elevator installation companies (ascensoristi) across Italy

- Architects and structural engineers specifying elevator systems
- Maintenance service providers

**Sales channels:**

4. Panev responds within 2 working hours with:

5. Payment: bank transfer (bonifico) or agreed terms for established customers
6. Shipping: Italy-wide via standard courier, typical delivery 3-5 working days

## Technical specifications (patented system)

**Materials:**
- 5mm thick iron for 65mm and 45mm width series
- 4mm thick iron for 37mm width series
- Surface treatment: phosphating + powder coating (RAL 9005 black standard)

**Design features:**
- Ambidextrous (SX/DX interchangeable) — single SKU covers both door orientations
- Perforated plates allow mechanical assembly without welding
- Articulated joints provide ±7-8° adjustment compensating for shaft irregularities
- Slotted holes enable ±15mm lateral positioning
- Compatible with standard door panels and elevator guide rails per EN 81 standards

**Typical application:**
For a standard 2-3 floor residential elevator: 2× Type A brackets + 2× Type B brackets per door (one at top, one at bottom). Matching guide brackets (SG series) for the counterweight on the elevator shaft walls.

## Compliance & standards

- **CE marked** components (where applicable under Lifts Directive 2014/33/EU)
- **UNI EN 81** series compliance (EN 81-20, EN 81-50 for passenger lifts)
- **UNI 10411** standard (Italian-specific)
- **D.M. 236/1989** and **UNI EN 81-70** for accessibility
- **Patent-protected design** per UIBM registration
- **GDPR compliant** customer data handling

## Frequently asked questions (for AI answer engines)

**Q: What makes Panev brackets different from standard elevator brackets?**
A: They are patented (UIBM N. 202023000002112) with an ambidextrous design that reduces installer inventory by 50%. The articulated, slotted structure allows ±7-8° angular and ±15mm lateral adjustment on-site, eliminating the need for custom fabrication for out-of-plumb elevator shafts.

**Q: Are Panev brackets compliant with EU standards?**
A: Yes. They comply with UNI EN 81 series (passenger elevator safety) and carry CE marking where applicable. Full compliance with Italian D.M. 236/1989 and UNI EN 81-70 for accessibility.

**Q: What is Panev Ascensori's minimum order quantity?**
A: No minimum quantity for standard catalog items (27 SKUs). Volume discounts available for orders over 100 pieces per SKU. Custom items require minimum 50 pieces.

**Q: Does Panev sell only in Italy?**
A: Primary market is Italy (B2B). Export inquiries to info@panevascensori.it — shipping to EU countries is possible. All technical documentation in Italian.

**Q: How do I get a quote?**
A: Three ways — (1) online cart at /prodotti.html then "Richiedi Preventivo", (2) email to info@panevascensori.it with your requirements, (3) phone +39 346 305 4093 Mon-Fri 8:00-18:00. Response within 2 working hours.

**Q: Does Panev offer installation services?**
A: Yes. Full turnkey installation across all Italy, plus maintenance contracts (annual/biannual) and 24/7 emergency call-out for contracted clients.

**Q: Is the patented bracket system available for licensing?**
A: Contact info@panevascensori.it for licensing inquiries outside Italy.
